guideTitle: 6 Best Non Slip Bathtub Mats in 2026
metaTitle: Best Non Slip Bathtub Mats in 2026
metaDescription: Six non slip bathtub mats compared by tub fit, suction cup count, material and family use, from 40 inch adult mats to soft rubber mats for small children.
introParagraphs: A bathtub is a specific problem for a mat: the floor is a smooth, glazed curve of acrylic, porcelain or fiberglass, the walls rise steeply at the sides, and everyone in the household from toddlers to grandparents steps on the same few square feet. A good tub mat has to match the flat part of the tub floor, seal on a glossy surface and be soft enough for a child and grippy enough for an adult.

The six picks cover the range: the YINENN 40 by 16 inch vinyl mat with 200 cups, the GORILLA GRIP 35 by 16 inch mat with hundreds of cups and drain holes, the TEESHLY 39 by 16 inch vinyl mat that is 30 percent longer than standard, the OTHWAY with 198 cups and 360 drain holes, the Munchkin Soft Spot cushioned mat at 36 by 17 inches and the UNEEDE natural rubber mat with 113 cups and 46 drain holes.

We evaluated each on fit, grip, material, drainage and who it suits. Measure the flat floor of your tub, not the top, and clean the floor before the first use. A mat helps with footing, but it is no substitute for supervision of small children, and it works best alongside a grab bar for adults. The slope of a tub floor toward the drain is the detail most buyers overlook. We keep the guidance simple: measure, clean, press and dry.

products.name: YINENN Bath and Shower Safety Mats, 40x16 Inch, 200 Suction Cups
products.description:
YINENN's mat is a 40 by 16 inch rectangle in vinyl the listing describes as free of chemical smell, with 200 suction cups that hold on smooth surfaces and a pebble design that gives a massage feel underfoot. The heavy-duty build and standard dimensions are meant to fit most bathtubs and stalls. The length covers a long tub floor.

Two hundred cups on 40 inches is a reasonable density, and a no-smell material matters for a mat that sits in a small, humid room. Vinyl is firm and durable but less flexible than TPE. The listing does not give a drain hole count in the text we have.

Compared with the GORILLA GRIP it is longer, and compared with the TEESHLY it states a cup count. It suits a long, smooth tub where a firm, long mat with a stated cup count is wanted. If the drain is at one end, set the mat a few inches away from it so that water runs freely past. A quick press from the center to each end helps the cups seat evenly along the length.
products.bestFor: A long, firm mat with a stated cup count.
pros: 40 by 16 in covers a long tub
cons: Drain hole count is not stated in the text we have
Vinyl is less flexible than TPE

products.name: GORILLA GRIP Bath Tub Shower Mat, 35x16 Clear, Machine Washable
products.description:
GORILLA GRIP's tub mat is the one most others are compared against: 35 by 16 inches, hundreds of suction cups, hundreds of drain holes, a BPA-free build, a hexagon pebble-textured top and machine washable care. The patented design is built for a standard tub. It is available in several colors, and the listing mentions clear and clear blue.

A standard 35-inch length fits most tub floors without running up the curved ends, which is a practical advantage over longer mats. The pebble top is gentle underfoot. The listing does not state a cup count in the text we have.

Compared with the YINENN it is shorter and washable, and compared with the OTHWAY it gives fewer numbers. It suits a standard tub and a buyer who wants a dependable, washable mat in a familiar brand. If you are on the fence about size, tape a 35 inch strip of paper on the tub floor first to see how much of the floor it covers. A clear mat makes it easy to see the tub floor beneath, which shows whether the floor is clean.
products.bestFor: A standard tub and a dependable, washable mat.
pros: Hundreds of suction cups and drain holes
cons: Cup count is not stated in the text we have

products.name: TEESHLY Bathtub Mat, 39 x 16 Inch, 30% Longer, Suction Cups
products.description:
TEESHLY's 39 by 16 inch mat is described as 30 percent longer than standard mats, with suction cups, drain holes and a domed, pebble-like design whose irregular texture adds grip. It is made of high-quality vinyl. The listing frames it as suitable for use on the tub or shower floor.

A 39-inch mat gives more landing area and fewer bare patches in a long tub. The domed texture adds a massage-like feel, which some people enjoy and others find bumpy. The listing does not give a cup count in the text we have.

Compared with the YINENN it is an inch shorter and states no cups, and compared with the GORILLA GRIP it is longer. It suits a long tub where more coverage is wanted and a domed surface is welcome. On a tub with a pronounced curve at the ends, trim nothing and instead leave a gap at each end so that the mat lies flat. It is a good fit for a household that wants a long mat without paying for extras.
products.bestFor: More coverage in a long tub.
pros: 39 in length covers a long tub
cons: Cup count is not stated in the text we have
Long mat may ride up curved ends

products.name: OTHWAY Non Slip Bath Tub Shower Mat, 198 Cups, 360 Drain Holes
products.description:
OTHWAY states both its cups and its drain holes, 198 high-density suction cups and 360 precision-angled holes compared with 250 on what it calls standard mats, in a flexible TPE body with raised nodules. For a tub, where water drains toward a single point at one end, quick drainage keeps the mat from floating. TPE flexes with the slight curve of a tub floor.

Flexibility is a tub-specific advantage, since a stiff mat can ride up the gentle slope toward the drain. Stated numbers help you compare. The listing does not give dimensions in the text we have, so measure the listing's size against your tub floor.

Compared with the YINENN it states drain holes and uses TPE, and compared with the TEESHLY it gives counts. It suits a tub with a slightly curved floor and a buyer who wants stated numbers. Because TPE does not soak up water, hanging it for an hour after the bath is usually enough to dry it. Check the product page for dimensions, since the text we have leaves them out.
products.bestFor: A flexible mat for a tub with a gently curved floor.
pros: Flexible TPE follows a curved floor
cons: Dimensions are not stated in the text we have

Munchkin's Soft Spot is a cushioned mat, 36 by 17 inches, with a built-in textured grip and strong-hold suction cups, described as working with most smooth bath and shower surfaces. It is sold as a baby bath mat, so the cushioning and soft feel are aimed at small children. It is a wider mat than most at 17 inches.

That design makes it a useful family mat, soft enough for a child kneeling in the tub and grippy enough to stay put. The cushion is a comfort feature, and no mat replaces supervision of a small child in the bath. The listing does not give a cup count or care instructions in the text we have.

Compared with the adult vinyl mats it is softer, and compared with the UNEEDE it is a cushioned foam-type mat rather than natural rubber. It suits a household with small children that also wants a comfortable mat for adults. Lay a towel on the mat's edge while bathing a child, which helps protect knees and gives a softer kneeling spot. Wipe the cushion with a damp cloth between baths, and let it air dry fully.

products.description:
UNEEDE makes a toddler-sized tub mat in natural rubber with 113 heavy-duty suction cups and 46 drain holes, shaped like a sheep. The listing says the rubber is much softer and more cushioned than typical mats, and describes it as premium and skin-friendly. It is a small, themed mat, not a full-length adult tub liner.

Natural rubber is soft and grippy, which suits a small child's feet, and a smaller mat is easy to lift and rinse. The 46 holes are relatively few compared with the large adult mats, so lift and dry it after each bath. The listing's size is not stated in the text we have, and the playful shape is a children's feature.

Compared with the Munchkin it is rubber and smaller, and compared with the adult mats it suits a different user. It suits a family with a toddler who wants a soft, natural-rubber mat in the tub. If your toddler is likely to chew on things, check the mat after each bath for any signs of damage. Rinse it and hang it after each bath so that the rubber stays fresh.

buyingCriteria.explanation: A tub floor is smaller than the tub's top. Measure the flat section from end to end and side to side, and stay clear of the curves. A mat that runs up the curved ends lifts. The YINENN at 40 inches suits long tubs, and the GORILLA GRIP at 35 inches suits most.

Tub floors are smooth and glossy, which is ideal for suction, provided they are clean. The YINENN lists 200 cups, the OTHWAY 198 and the UNEEDE 113. Soap film breaks the seal, so clean the floor and press the mat down. A refinished or textured tub will not hold cups.

TPE on the OTHWAY and natural rubber on the UNEEDE flex with a gentle tub curve, while vinyl on the YINENN and TEESHLY is firmer. A flexible mat keeps more cups in contact. Flex the mat in your hands to judge. Bend the mat gently in your hands, and check that it springs back flat rather than holding the bend, which tells you how well it will follow a tub curve.

Tub water runs toward one end, and a mat can dam it. The OTHWAY lists 360 holes, the GORILLA GRIP hundreds and the UNEEDE 46. Good drainage prevents floating and mildew. Position the mat so that holes sit over the flat area.

A household with children may want the Munchkin Soft Spot or the UNEEDE, while adults may prefer a long vinyl or TPE mat. A mat that suits both is ideal. Never rely on a mat to keep a small child safe in a bath. Think about whether the person who bathes in the tub most often can easily lift, rinse and hang the mat, since that decides whether the routine will happen.

The GORILLA GRIP is machine washable, and others rinse clean. Lift the mat after each bath and hang it so that it dries. A cushioned mat dries slowly. A clean mat grips better. Choose a mat color that contrasts with the tub, because a visible mat is easier to check for shifting.

faq.q: What size bathtub mat do I need?
faq.a: Measure the flat tub floor, not the top. Most standard tubs suit a 35 by 16 inch mat, and long tubs suit 39 or 40 inches. A mat that runs up the curve will lift. Run a hand across the tub floor before you buy, because even a smooth tub can have a slightly satin finish that suction cups like less than gloss.

faq.q: Why does my tub mat float?
faq.a: Water under the mat lifts it, and soap film breaks the seal. Clean the floor, press the mat flat and choose a mat with good drainage, such as the OTHWAY with 360 holes. Lift and dry the mat after each bath. If you notice a mat drifting along the length of the tub, the floor may slope more than you thought, and a slightly shorter mat may sit flatter.

faq.q: Can a mat keep a toddler safe in the tub?
faq.a: No. A mat gives some grip, but a small child must be supervised at all times in the bath. Use a soft mat like the Munchkin or UNEEDE for comfort and stay within arm's reach. A rubber mat can smell when new, so rinse it and let it air for a day before the first bath.

faq.q: Do tub mats work on a refinished tub?
faq.a: Suction cups may not seal and could pull at a new finish. Look at non-suction mats for refinished or textured tubs. Check the refinisher's care instructions. Remember to press every cup, including those at the edges, which are the first to lift if they have not sealed.

faq.q: How do I clean a tub mat?
faq.a: Lift it after each bath, rinse both sides and hang to dry. Wash weekly with mild soap, or machine wash on cold if the listing allows, as with the GORILLA GRIP. Warm water helps vinyl and rubber relax and lie flat, so a quick rinse with warm water before placing the mat can help.

faq.q: Is a longer mat always better?
faq.a: Only if your tub floor is flat for that length. A mat that is too long rides up the curved ends. Measure first. If the mat has been in storage, check for stiffness or cracks before use and replace it if the surface looks worn. Keep a small bottle of mild soap near the tub so that you can wash the floor whenever it feels slick.
